jp: \t\t薬効のある小さな実。発酵させることで毒性が消え、立派なエール酒となる。一方で、乾燥させると強烈な中毒性を持つ麻薬になるため、密造する者があとを絶たない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t薬効のある小さな実。発酵させることで毒性が消え、立派なエール酒となる。一方で、乾燥させると強烈な中毒性を持つ麻薬になるため、密造する者があとを絶たない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Small berries with medicinal properties. When fermented, the toxicity disappears and it makes an excellent ale. On the other hand, when dried, it becomes a highly addictive narcotic, making it a favorite of many smugglers. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Small berries with medicinal properties. When fermented, the toxicity disappears and it makes an excellent ale. On the other hand, when dried, it becomes a highly addictive narcotic, making it a favorite of many smugglers. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una bacca piccola che ha proprietà medicinali. A farla fermentare il veleno se ne va e ne viene una birra come si deve. A seccarla, invece, diventa una droga che dà una dipendenza fortissima, e per questo chi la lavora di nascosto non finisce mai. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tつやつやした光沢をもつ紫色の野菜。実の部分はスポンジ状になっており、水や油が染み込みやすい。淡白な味で、他の食材ともよく調和する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tつやつやした光沢をもつ紫色の野菜。実の部分はスポンジ状になっており、水や油が染み込みやすい。淡白な味で、他の食材ともよく調和する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A glossy, shiny purple vegetable. The fruit is spongy and easily soaks up water and oil. It has a light flavor and blends well with other ingredients.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A glossy, shiny purple vegetable. The fruit is spongy and easily soaks up water and oil. It has a light flavor and blends well with other ingredients.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una verdura viola con una lucentezza lucida. La polpa è come una spugna e si beve facilmente l'acqua e l'olio. Ha un sapore delicato e sta bene insieme agli altri ingredienti.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t綺麗に並んだ黄色い粒が美しい作物。生食にはあまり向かず、収穫時の新鮮な味わいは収穫後すぐに失われてしまう。ちなみにヒゲのような部分には利尿作用がある。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t綺麗に並んだ黄色い粒が美しい作物。生食にはあまり向かず、収穫時の新鮮な味わいは収穫後すぐに失われてしまう。ちなみにヒゲのような部分には利尿作用がある。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Crop with beautifully aligned yellow grains. It is not suitable for eating raw, and the fresh taste at harvest is lost soon after harvest.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Crop with beautifully aligned yellow grains. It is not suitable for eating raw, and the fresh taste at harvest is lost soon after harvest.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una pianta bella da vedere, coi chicchi gialli allineati per bene. Cruda non va tanto, e il sapore fresco che ha appena colta lo perde subito dopo. Fra l'altro, la parte che pare una barba fa venire da urinare.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tイーモとほぼ同種だが、大きくてやや不格好。煮込んでも煮崩れしないため煮物に適している。皮や芽に毒を含むため、食べる前は入念にそぎ落とさないと危険。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイーモとほぼ同種だが、大きくてやや不格好。煮込んでも煮崩れしないため煮物に適している。皮や芽に毒を含むため、食べる前は入念にそぎ落とさないと危険。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Crop that is suitable for stewing as it does not fall apart when cooked. The skin and buds contain poison, so it is dangerous to scrape them off carefully before eating.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Crop that is suitable for stewing as it does not fall apart when cooked. The skin and buds contain poison, so it is dangerous to scrape them off carefully before eating.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: È quasi la stessa specie dell'imo, ma più grande e un po' sgraziata. Bollendola non si sfa, quindi va bene per gli stufati. Buccia e germogli contengono veleno, e se prima di mangiarla non li togli con cura è pericolosa.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t爽やかな酸味と濃厚な甘みを併せ持つ果物。肉類の分解を助ける物質を含んでおり、肉を柔らかくすることもできる。大量に食べると口内の組織まで分解されてしまうので注意だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t爽やかな酸味と濃厚な甘みを併せ持つ果物。肉類の分解を助ける物質を含んでおり、肉を柔らかくすることもできる。大量に食べると口内の組織まで分解されてしまうので注意だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Fruit combining a refreshing acidity with a rich sweetness. It contains substances that help break down meat and can also tenderize it. Be careful not to eat too much, as it can break down the tissues in the mouth.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Fruit combining a refreshing acidity with a rich sweetness. It contains substances that help break down meat and can also tenderize it. Be careful not to eat too much, as it can break down the tissues in the mouth.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto che tiene insieme un'acidità fresca e una dolcezza piena. Contiene sostanze che aiutano a disfare la carne, e sa anche renderla tenera. Attento a non mangiarne troppo: disfa anche i tessuti dentro la bocca.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tシャリシャリとした食感の果物。甘く果汁が多いが、リンゴなどと同じく芯の辺りは酸味が強い。基本は生食であり、調理されることは少ない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tシャリシャリとした食感の果物。甘く果汁が多いが、リンゴなどと同じく芯の辺りは酸味が強い。基本は生食であり、調理されることは少ない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Fruit with a crunchy texture. Sweet and juicy, but like apples, the core is highly acidic. Universally eaten raw, and were rarely cooked.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Fruit with a crunchy texture. Sweet and juicy, but like apples, the core is highly acidic. Universally eaten raw, and were rarely cooked.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto che sotto i denti fa croc. È dolce e pieno di succo, ma come nella mela la parte vicina al torsolo è molto acida. Di base si mangia cruda, e cucinarla è raro.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t細長く歪曲した黄色の果実。おやつとして人気が高いが、栄養価が高く収量も多いため、主食としている国もある。熟したバナナを放っておくとすぐに痛んでしまうので注意。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t細長く歪曲した黄色の果実。おやつとして人気が高いが、栄養価が高く収量も多いため、主食としている国もある。熟したバナナを放っておくとすぐに痛んでしまうので注意。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A slender, curved yellow fruit. Popular as a snack, but also a staple food in some countries due to its high nutritional value and high yield. Note that ripe bananas can quickly become sore if left to ripen.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A slender, curved yellow fruit. Popular as a snack, but also a staple food in some countries due to its high nutritional value and high yield. Note that ripe bananas can quickly become sore if left to ripen.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto giallo, lungo e ricurvo. Piace molto come merenda, ma dà molto nutrimento e molto raccolto, e in certi paesi è il cibo principale. Attento: una banana matura, se la lasci lì, si guasta in fretta.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tやたら高級なことで知られる果実。品質の高いメロンで一獲千金を狙う農家も多い。スイカとどうしてここまで差がついたのかは不明。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tやたら高級なことで知られる果実。品質の高いメロンで一獲千金を狙う農家も多い。スイカとどうしてここまで差がついたのかは不明。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Fruits known for its high quality. Many farmers aim to make a fortune from high-quality muskmelons. It is not known how they became so different from watermelons.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Fruits known for its high quality. Many farmers aim to make a fortune from high-quality muskmelons. It is not known how they became so different from watermelons.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto famoso per essere carissimo. Molti contadini puntano a fare fortuna con meloni di gran qualità. Perché sia finito così lontano dall'anguria non si sa.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tウリの近種の野菜…なのだがその甘味からもっぱら果物として扱われる。長棒でたたき割って遊ぶこともできる、すばらしいフルーツだ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tウリの近種の野菜…なのだがその甘味からもっぱら果物として扱われる。長棒でたたき割って遊ぶこともできる、すばらしいフルーツだ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A close relative of the cucumber, it is a vegetable... but because of its sweetness, it is treated exclusively as a fruit. It is a wonderful fruit that can be smashed with a long stick.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A close relative of the cucumber, it is a vegetable... but because of its sweetness, it is treated exclusively as a fruit. It is a wonderful fruit that can be smashed with a long stick.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una verdura parente stretta della zucca... ma per quanto è dolce la trattano da frutto e basta. E ci si può anche giocare a spaccarla con un bastone lungo: un frutto splendido.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tトゲトゲしたイガを持つ果実。近年まで海産物のウニと混同されていたためか、一部の人たちには未だにウニ呼ばわりされている。ウニと比べるとトゲが短いため投げやすい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tトゲトゲしたイガを持つ果実。近年まで海産物のウニと混同されていたためか、一部の人たちには未だにウニ呼ばわりされている。ウニと比べるとトゲが短いため投げやすい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Nut with a spiky shell. It is still called sea urchin by some people, perhaps because it looks like one. It's shorter spikes makes it an excellent throwing weapon.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Nut with a spiky shell. It is still called sea urchin by some people, perhaps because it looks like one. It's shorter spikes makes it an excellent throwing weapon.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto chiuso in un riccio pieno di spine. Fino a poco tempo fa lo confondevano col riccio di mare, e forse per questo c'è ancora chi lo chiama riccio. Rispetto al riccio di mare ha le spine più corte, quindi si tira meglio.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「う、うにを粗末にするとバチが当たるんですよ！」\n#～怯える錬金術士の『ナプラス』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「う、うにを粗末にするとバチが当たるんですよ！」\n#～怯える錬金術士の『ナプラス』の言葉～\n"
en: A type of nut that restores satiety, it's used to make candies.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~
en_grezzo: "A type of nut that restores satiety, it's used to make candies.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~"
it: \"R-rovinare un riccio porta castigo!\"\n#~Parole di <Naplus> l'alchimista spaventata~

jp: \t\tカニによく似ているがヤドカリの仲間。加熱しないと繊維質が強靱で旨味も薄いため、基本的に茹でられた状態で流通している。茹でられる前の体色は暗紫色。弱りはするが、基本的に茹でられたくらいでは死なない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカニによく似ているがヤドカリの仲間。加熱しないと繊維質が強靱で旨味も薄いため、基本的に茹でられた状態で流通している。茹でられる前の体色は暗紫色。弱りはするが、基本的に茹でられたくらいでは死なない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: It is a member of the hermit crab family, although it looks a lot like a crab. They are generally distributed in a boiled state because their fibers are tough and tasteless without being cooked. Before being boiled, their body color is dark purple. Although they are boiled this way, they are still alive.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "It is a member of the hermit crab family, although it looks a lot like a crab. They are generally distributed in a boiled state because their fibers are tough and tasteless without being cooked. Before being boiled, their body color is dark purple. Although they are boiled this way, they are still alive.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Somiglia molto a un granchio, ma è parente del paguro. Se non lo si cuoce le fibre restano dure e il sapore è poco, quindi in giro lo si trova quasi sempre già bollito. Prima di bollirlo il colore del corpo è viola scuro. Si indebolisce, sì, ma di regola bollirlo tanto non basta a ucciderlo.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tマンドレイクの死体のうち植物体の部分を使用したサラダ。魔力そのものは含まれていないが、魔力を作り出す成分が大量に含まれている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tマンドレイクの死体のうち植物体の部分を使用したサラダ。魔力そのものは含まれていないが、魔力を作り出す成分が大量に含まれている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Salad made from the vegetative parts of mandrake corpses. It does not contain magic itself, but it does contain a large amount of ingredients that generate magic.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Salad made from the vegetative parts of mandrake corpses. It does not contain magic itself, but it does contain a large amount of ingredients that generate magic.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un'insalata fatta con la parte vegetale del cadavere di una mandragora. Forza magica non ne contiene, ma è piena di sostanze che la magia la producono.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t甘いお菓子。感謝の気持ちを伝えるために特定の日にチョコを贈る、という奇妙な風習が近年定着しつつある。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t甘いお菓子。感謝の気持ちを伝えるために特定の日にチョコを贈る、という奇妙な風習が近年定着しつつある。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Sweet treats. A strange custom of giving chocolate on certain days to express gratitude has taken hold in recent years. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Sweet treats. A strange custom of giving chocolate on certain days to express gratitude has taken hold in recent years. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un dolce. Da qualche anno sta prendendo piede l'usanza curiosa di regalare cioccolato in certi giorni per dire grazie. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tぶつ切りにしたイス種族の触手を小麦粉の生地の中に入れ球形に焼き上げた料理。微量に含まれる幻覚成分が隠し味。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tぶつ切りにしたイス種族の触手を小麦粉の生地の中に入れ球形に焼き上げた料理。微量に含まれる幻覚成分が隠し味。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Yith tentacles, chopped into small pieces, are placed in a flour dough and baked into a spherical shape. The secret of this dish is that it contains a trace amount of hallucinogenic ingredients. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Yith tentacles, chopped into small pieces, are placed in a flour dough and baked into a spherical shape. The secret of this dish is that it contains a trace amount of hallucinogenic ingredients. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un piatto fatto tagliando a pezzi i tentacoli della stirpe degli yith, mettendoli in un impasto di farina e cuocendoli a palline. L'ingrediente segreto è la piccola dose di sostanze che fanno vedere le allucinazioni. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t成分不明。怪しい臭いを放っており、食べるのを拒否したくなる。覚悟を決めた者だけが食べるべし。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t成分不明。怪しい臭いを放っており、食べるのを拒否したくなる。覚悟を決めた者だけが食べるべし。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Ingredients unknown. Emits a suspicious odor and makes one want to refuse to eat it. Only those who are prepared to eat it should do so. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Ingredients unknown. Emits a suspicious odor and makes one want to refuse to eat it. Only those who are prepared to eat it should do so. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Composizione ignota. Manda un odore sospetto che fa venir voglia di rifiutarsi di mangiarlo. Che lo mangi solo chi si è deciso davvero. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t食べるとたちまち子供になる不思議なお弁当。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食べるとたちまち子供になる不思議なお弁当。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Strange bentos that instantly turn you into a child when you eat them. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Strange bentos that instantly turn you into a child when you eat them. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un pranzo al sacco misterioso: a mangiarlo si torna bambini in un attimo. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t時を封じ込めたお弁当。絶対に食べてはいけない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t時を封じ込めたお弁当。絶対に食べてはいけない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Bento box lunches that contain time. Don't eat it. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Bento box lunches that contain time. Don't eat it. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un pranzo al sacco in cui è chiuso il tempo. Non si deve mangiare per nessun motivo. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t削った氷にシロップをかけて作った氷菓。急いで食べると頭がキーンとするが、これは咽頭への刺激を脳が頭痛と誤認知することによる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t削った氷にシロップをかけて作った氷菓。急いで食べると頭がキーンとするが、これは咽頭への刺激を脳が頭痛と誤認知することによる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: An icy treat made by pouring syrup over shaved ice. When eaten in a hurry, it causes a sharp headache, which is due to the brain's misidentification of the stimulation to the pharynx. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "An icy treat made by pouring syrup over shaved ice. When eaten in a hurry, it causes a sharp headache, which is due to the brain's misidentification of the stimulation to the pharynx. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un dolce di ghiaccio, fatto versando lo sciroppo sul ghiaccio tritato. A mangiarlo di fretta viene una fitta alla testa, e il motivo è che il cervello scambia per mal di testa quel che si sente in gola. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t商売が上手くいかずに絶望したキャラメル職人が最後に作った一品。終末を呼び起こす。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t商売が上手くいかずに絶望したキャラメル職人が最後に作った一品。終末を呼び起こす。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: One of the last products made by a caramel maker in despair after his business failed. It evokes an apocalypse. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "One of the last products made by a caramel maker in despair after his business failed. It evokes an apocalypse. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: L'ultima cosa che fece un caramellaio disperato perché il lavoro non gli andava. Chiama la fine del mondo. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「明日は借金の取り立て日だってのに金が用意できてねぇ…明日世界が滅びればいいのに…」\n#～廃業寸前のキャラメル職人の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「明日は借金の取り立て日だってのに金が用意できてねぇ…明日世界が滅びればいいのに…」\n#～廃業寸前のキャラメル職人の言葉～\n"
en: \"Tomorrow is the day for debt collection, and I don't have the money ready... I wish the world would end tomorrow...\" \n# ~an Indebted Caramel Maker~
en_grezzo: "\"Tomorrow is the day for debt collection, and I don't have the money ready... I wish the world would end tomorrow...\" \n# ~an Indebted Caramel Maker~"
it: \"Domani viene chi riscuote il debito e i soldi non li ho... magari domani il mondo finisse...\" \n# ~Parole di un Caramellaio sull'Orlo del Fallimento~

jp: \t\t米を握り固めて味付けしたシンプルな料理。片手間でも素早く食べることができるのが特徴。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t米を握り固めて味付けしたシンプルな料理。片手間でも素早く食べることができるのが特徴。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Simple dish of rice, hardened and seasoned with a firm fist. It is characterized by its ability to be eaten quickly, even with one hand. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Simple dish of rice, hardened and seasoned with a firm fist. It is characterized by its ability to be eaten quickly, even with one hand. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un piatto semplice: riso stretto in mano fino a compattarlo e insaporito. Quel che lo distingue è che si mangia in fretta, anche mentre fai altro. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tとろりとした舌触りとぷちぷちした歯ごたえのコンビネーションが人気の食べ物。かつては洗ったプチをそのまま使っていたが、油断した客が逆にプチに食べられてしまう事件が何度も起きたため、現在は仮死状態にしたプチを使用している。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tとろりとした舌触りとぷちぷちした歯ごたえのコンビネーションが人気の食べ物。かつては洗ったプチをそのまま使っていたが、油断した客が逆にプチに食べられてしまう事件が何度も起きたため、現在は仮死状態にしたプチを使用している。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: The combination of a thick texture and a crunchy texture makes it a popular food. In the past, washed Putits were used directly, but due to numerous incidents of unwary customers being eaten by Putits, they now use Putits that have been put in a state of suspended animation. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "The combination of a thick texture and a crunchy texture makes it a popular food. In the past, washed Putits were used directly, but due to numerous incidents of unwary customers being eaten by Putits, they now use Putits that have been put in a state of suspended animation. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un cibo che piace per come mette insieme il morbido che si scioglie e i granelli che scrocchiano sotto i denti. Un tempo si usavano putit lavati e basta, ma siccome è successo più volte che un cliente distratto finisse mangiato dal putit, adesso si usano putit messi in morte apparente. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「ほら見てごらんよリリィ、このプチなかなか活きがいい…ぬわーーっっ！！」\n#～犠牲者の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「ほら見てごらんよリリィ、このプチなかなか活きがいい…ぬわーーっっ！！」\n#～犠牲者の言葉～\n"
en: \"Look at this Lily, this Putit is quite lively... wait.. noooooooooooo! \" \n# ~Victim's Last Words~
en_grezzo: "\"Look at this Lily, this Putit is quite lively... wait.. noooooooooooo! \" \n# ~Victim's Last Words~"
it: \"Guarda un po', <Lily>, questo putit è proprio vivace... uwaaa!!\" \n# ~Le Ultime Parole della Vittima~

jp: \t\t工程に独自の要素を加えることで、よりふんわりとした触感を得たパン。その柔らかさは触った時もさることながら、口にすれば一層はっきりとわかるだろう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t工程に独自の要素を加えることで、よりふんわりとした触感を得たパン。その柔らかさは触った時もさることながら、口にすれば一層はっきりとわかるだろう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: By adding unique elements to the process, the bread has a fluffier texture. The softness of the bread is not only apparent when you touch it, but it is even more obvious when you taste it. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "By adding unique elements to the process, the bread has a fluffier texture. The softness of the bread is not only apparent when you touch it, but it is even more obvious when you taste it. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un pane a cui, aggiungendo qualcosa di proprio alla lavorazione, hanno dato una consistenza più soffice. La morbidezza si sente già a toccarlo, ma in bocca si capisce molto meglio. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「お、お姉ちゃんの作ったふかふかパンはおいしいなぁ！」\n#～吐き気をこらえる少女の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「お、お姉ちゃんの作ったふかふかパンはおいしいなぁ！」\n#～吐き気をこらえる少女の言葉～\n"
en: \"Oh, the fluffy bread made by my big sister is delicious!\" \n# ~a girl with nausea~
en_grezzo: "\"Oh, the fluffy bread made by my big sister is delicious!\" \n# ~a girl with nausea~"
it: \"I-il pane soffice che ha fatto la mia sorella maggiore è buonissimo!\" \n# ~Parole di una Bambina che Trattiene la Nausea~

jp: \t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。甘味を加えることは勿論、少量を用いることで食材の持つ旨味と塩味を引き出す効果を持つ優れた調味料だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。甘味を加えることは勿論、少量を用いることで食材の持つ旨味と塩味を引き出す効果を持つ優れた調味料だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. It is an excellent seasoning that not only adds sweetness, but also brings out the umami and saltiness of the ingredients when used in small quantities. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. It is an excellent seasoning that not only adds sweetness, but also brings out the umami and saltiness of the ingredients when used in small quantities. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Uno dei condimenti di base che decidono se un piatto riesce o no. Aggiunge dolcezza, certo, ma è anche un ottimo condimento perché, usato in poca quantità, tira fuori il sapore pieno e il salato che l'ingrediente ha già. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。塩味を加えることは勿論、少量を用いることで食材の持つ旨味と甘味を引き出す効果を持つ優れた調味料だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。塩味を加えることは勿論、少量を用いることで食材の持つ旨味と甘味を引き出す効果を持つ優れた調味料だ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. While it obviously imparts a salty flavor on any food, using it sparingly can bring out the ingredients' natural sweetness and umami, making for an excellent seasoning in moderation.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~\n
en_grezzo: "One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. While it obviously imparts a salty flavor on any food, using it sparingly can bring out the ingredients' natural sweetness and umami, making for an excellent seasoning in moderation.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~\n"
it: Uno dei condimenti di base che decidono se un piatto riesce o no. Aggiunge sapore salato, certo, ma è anche un ottimo condimento perché, usato in poca quantità, tira fuori il sapore pieno e il dolce che l'ingrediente ha già.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~\n

jp: \t\t口に放り込むと溢れんばかりの肉汁であなたを満たす、とてもおいしい料理。素材に何が使われているかなんて、聞くだけ野暮ってものだろう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t口に放り込むと溢れんばかりの肉汁であなたを満たす、とてもおいしい料理。素材に何が使われているかなんて、聞くだけ野暮ってものだろう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A very tasty dish that fills you with juices that overflow when you put it in your mouth. It's probably a silly question to ask what ingredients are used. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A very tasty dish that fills you with juices that overflow when you put it in your mouth. It's probably a silly question to ask what ingredients are used. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un piatto buonissimo che, appena te lo metti in bocca, ti riempie di un sugo che trabocca. Chiedere che cosa ci sia dentro sarebbe soltanto di cattivo gusto. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「フム。口に入れた時の食感、そこから勢いよく溢れだすジューシーな肉汁、後を引くような独特の味。この料理は私が今まで食べた中で最高位に値するよ。…ところで、これには何の肉が使われているのかね」\n#～偉大なる料理評論家グラトナの言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「フム。口に入れた時の食感、そこから勢いよく溢れだすジューシーな肉汁、後を引くような独特の味。この料理は私が今まで食べた中で最高位に値するよ。…ところで、これには何の肉が使われているのかね」\n#～偉大なる料理評論家グラトナの言葉～\n"
en: \"Hm. The texture when you put it in your mouth, the juicy meat juices that pour out of it with great vigor, and the unique flavor that lingers in your mouth. This dish deserves the highest rank I have ever had. By the way, what kind of meat is used in this dish?\" \n# ~ Words of the great food critic, Gratona ~
en_grezzo: "\"Hm. The texture when you put it in your mouth, the juicy meat juices that pour out of it with great vigor, and the unique flavor that lingers in your mouth. This dish deserves the highest rank I have ever had. By the way, what kind of meat is used in this dish?\" \n# ~ Words of the great food critic, Gratona ~"
it: \"Uhm. La consistenza appena entra in bocca, il sugo che ne esce fuori con impeto, quel sapore tutto suo che resta. Questo piatto merita il posto più alto fra quanti ne ho mangiati. ...A proposito, che carne ci mettono dentro?\" \n# ~Parole di <Gratona>, grande critico gastronomico~

jp: \t\t太陽の恵みを一身に受けた酸味の強い野菜。色々な調理法のある野菜だが、変わった所では、生の状態を輪切りにして、砂糖をつけて食べたりする食べ方もあるとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t太陽の恵みを一身に受けた酸味の強い野菜。色々な調理法のある野菜だが、変わった所では、生の状態を輪切りにして、砂糖をつけて食べたりする食べ方もあるとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Vegetable with a strong acidity that has received all the blessings of the sun. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, but one unusual way to eat it is to cut it raw into round slices and dip it in sugar.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Vegetable with a strong acidity that has received all the blessings of the sun. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, but one unusual way to eat it is to cut it raw into round slices and dip it in sugar.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una verdura molto acida che si è presa addosso tutto il bene del sole. La si cucina in molti modi, ma fra i più strani c'è chi la taglia a fette da cruda e la mangia con lo zucchero sopra.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t異国から伝わりし白い悪魔。香ばしい匂いと柔らかい触感で人を手招きするが、食べたが最後、奴は喉元で急に歩みを止め、突然食べた者の行動と意識を奪うのだ！　もしそうなった時は近くの人に助けてもらおう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国から伝わりし白い悪魔。香ばしい匂いと柔らかい触感で人を手招きするが、食べたが最後、奴は喉元で急に歩みを止め、突然食べた者の行動と意識を奪うのだ！　もしそうなった時は近くの人に助けてもらおう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: The white devil from a foreign land. It beckons people with its savory smell and soft touch, but once it has been eaten, it will suddenly pause at the throat and deprive the eater of action and consciousness! If this happens, get help from someone nearby.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "The white devil from a foreign land. It beckons people with its savory smell and soft touch, but once it has been eaten, it will suddenly pause at the throat and deprive the eater of action and consciousness! If this happens, get help from someone nearby.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Il demone bianco venuto da un paese straniero. Ti chiama con l'odore invitante e con la morbidezza, ma una volta che l'hai mangiato si ferma di colpo in gola e ti toglie di botto i movimenti e i sensi! Se ti succede, fatti aiutare da chi ti sta vicino.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t祝いの品々で飾られた特別な餅。神の祝福を受けたありがたい餅だが、気にすることなく食すことができる。しかし、神といえど餅の詰まりはどうすることもできない。食べる時は身の周りに十分気をつけよう。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祝いの品々で飾られた特別な餅。神の祝福を受けたありがたい餅だが、気にすることなく食すことができる。しかし、神といえど餅の詰まりはどうすることもできない。食べる時は身の周りに十分気をつけよう。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: Special rice cake decorated with festive items. A grateful rice cake blessed by God, but eaten without concern. However, God cannot do anything about the rice cake getting stuck in your throat. So be careful when eating it. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "Special rice cake decorated with festive items. A grateful rice cake blessed by God, but eaten without concern. However, God cannot do anything about the rice cake getting stuck in your throat. So be careful when eating it. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un mochi speciale, ornato con le cose di festa. È un mochi benedetto e degno di riconoscenza, ma lo si può mangiare senza pensarci. Contro un mochi che va di traverso, però, non può niente nemmeno un dio: quando lo mangi, guardati bene intorno. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\tあなたもわたしもフォーチュン！フォーチュン！　そっと一口食べたなら、きっと幸せ届きます。あーっと全部食べたなら、神のお告げがあなたの元へ。\n#～袋の裏に書かれた端書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tあなたもわたしもフォーチュン！フォーチュン！　そっと一口食べたなら、きっと幸せ届きます。あーっと全部食べたなら、神のお告げがあなたの元へ。\n#～袋の裏に書かれた端書～\n"
en: Fortune for you and me! Fortune! If you take a bite gently, happiness will surely arrive. If you ate the whole thing, God's blessing will come to you. \n# ~Note Written on the Back of the Bag~
en_grezzo: "Fortune for you and me! Fortune! If you take a bite gently, happiness will surely arrive. If you ate the whole thing, God's blessing will come to you. \n# ~Note Written on the Back of the Bag~"
it: Fortuna per te e fortuna per me! Fortuna! Se ne dai un morso piano piano, la felicità di sicuro ti arriva. Se lo mangi tutto in un colpo, ti arriva il responso di un dio. \n# ~Postilla Scritta sul Retro del Sacco~

jp: \t\t古来から幸運の証とされてきた兎の尾の部分。装飾品にする地方もあるらしいが、食することによって直接幸運を取りこむと考えるのが古から伝わるノースティリスの教えだ。\n#～鉄の胃袋を求めて・完食列伝～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古来から幸運の証とされてきた兎の尾の部分。装飾品にする地方もあるらしいが、食することによって直接幸運を取りこむと考えるのが古から伝わるノースティリスの教えだ。\n#～鉄の胃袋を求めて・完食列伝～\n"
en: The tail of a rabbit has been considered a sign of good luck since ancient times. Some regions use it as an ornament, but the ancient North Tyris belief is that eating it brings good luck. \n#~Iron Stomach: A Complete Diet~
en_grezzo: "The tail of a rabbit has been considered a sign of good luck since ancient times. Some regions use it as an ornament, but the ancient North Tyris belief is that eating it brings good luck. \n#~Iron Stomach: A Complete Diet~"
it: La parte della coda del coniglio, che fin dai tempi antichi è segno di fortuna. Pare che in certe zone se ne faccia un ornamento, ma l'insegnamento antico di Tyris del Nord è che mangiandola la fortuna te la prendi dentro direttamente. \n#~In Cerca di uno Stomaco di Ferro: Piatti Finiti~

jp: \t\tあなたの為だけに妹が作ったお弁当。愛があるので決して腐らない。食べるだけで周囲にマイナスイオンが発生し、驚異的なリラクゼーション効果があると言われているが、未だ私は食べたことが無い…。\n#～妹研究の第一人者モクシスの研究論文～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tあなたの為だけに妹が作ったお弁当。愛があるので決して腐らない。食べるだけで周囲にマイナスイオンが発生し、驚異的なリラクゼーション効果があると言われているが、未だ私は食べたことが無い…。\n#～妹研究の第一人者モクシスの研究論文～\n"
en: A lunch made by your younger sister just for you. It never spoils because of love. It is said that just eating it generates negative ions around you and has an amazing relaxation effect, but I have yet to eat it... \n# ~report of <Moxis>, leading imouto researcher~
en_grezzo: "A lunch made by your younger sister just for you. It never spoils because of love. It is said that just eating it generates negative ions around you and has an amazing relaxation effect, but I have yet to eat it... \n# ~report of <Moxis>, leading imouto researcher~"
it: Un pranzo al sacco che tua sorella minore ha fatto solo per te. C'è dentro l'amore, quindi non va mai a male. Dicono che soltanto a mangiarlo intorno si formino ioni negativi e che l'effetto di rilassamento sia straordinario, ma io non l'ho ancora mai mangiato... \n# ~Studio di <Moxis>, massimo esperto di sorelle minori~

jp: \t\t食べると頭に知識の泉が湧くとされる果実。さる高名な魔法使いはこの果実を恒久的に手に入れられるよう、自らの知識を全て費やして研究したが、結局繁殖させるには至らなかったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食べると頭に知識の泉が湧くとされる果実。さる高名な魔法使いはこの果実を恒久的に手に入れられるよう、自らの知識を全て費やして研究したが、結局繁殖させるには至らなかったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It is said that when eaten, a fountain of knowledge springs up in one's head. A famous wizard spent all his knowledge in researching this fruit so that he could obtain it permanently, but in the end he was unable to propagate it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It is said that when eaten, a fountain of knowledge springs up in one's head. A famous wizard spent all his knowledge in researching this fruit so that he could obtain it permanently, but in the end he was unable to propagate it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un frutto che, dicono, a mangiarlo fa sgorgare in testa una fonte di sapere. Un mago di gran fama, per averne per sempre, ci spese sopra tutto il suo sapere; ma alla fine a farlo crescere non ci riuscì. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t食べると生命力がみなぎるとされる、香しいチーズ。古の時代より、勇猛果敢な英雄達が好んで食べていたとされる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食べると生命力がみなぎるとされる、香しいチーズ。古の時代より、勇猛果敢な英雄達が好んで食べていたとされる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Fragrant cheese that is said to be full of life force when eaten. Since ancient times, it is said to have been a favorite food of brave and daring heroes. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Fragrant cheese that is said to be full of life force when eaten. Since ancient times, it is said to have been a favorite food of brave and daring heroes. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un formaggio profumato che, dicono, a mangiarlo riempie di forza vitale. Fin dai tempi antichi, si racconta, era il preferito degli eroi coraggiosi e arditi. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t仄かに金色に輝く珍しいリンゴ。中にはたっぷりの蜜と幸運が含まれているとされ、過去この奇跡の果物を求め人々は大陸をさまよい歩いたという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仄かに金色に輝く珍しいリンゴ。中にはたっぷりの蜜と幸運が含まれているとされ、過去この奇跡の果物を求め人々は大陸をさまよい歩いたという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A rare apple with a faint golden color. It is said to contain plenty of honey and good fortune, and in the past, people wandered the continent in search of this miraculous fruit. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A rare apple with a faint golden color. It is said to contain plenty of honey and good fortune, and in the past, people wandered the continent in search of this miraculous fruit. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una mela rara che luccica appena di un colore d'oro. Dentro, dicono, c'è miele in abbondanza e insieme la fortuna, e in passato la gente vagò per il continente in cerca di questo frutto miracoloso. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~
